08 — DELIVERY FRAMEWORK

Our 9-Stage Business-First Delivery Framework

Technology follows business understanding—not the other way around. Every stage informs the next from process discovery to long-term SLA support.

01 Business Understanding

Discovery

Align business objectives, stakeholder priorities, and measurable success criteria.

02 Business Understanding

Process Mapping

Map existing workflows, department handoffs, manual bottlenecks, and decision points.

03 Business Understanding

AI Opportunity Mapping

Score where AI and automation create measurable ROI vs. where human judgment leads.

04 Design & Build

Architecture

Design scalable database schemas, role permissions, API integrations, and security.

05 Design & Build

UI/UX Wireframing

Craft role-based dashboards and operational interfaces around how teams work daily.

06 Design & Build

System Engineering

Build production CRM, ERP, HRMS, web, and mobile modules with clean, testable code.

07 Deliver & Evolve

Quality Assurance

Validate end-to-end workflow scenarios, edge cases, load performance, and security.

08 Deliver & Evolve

Deployment & Training

Execute zero-downtime data migration, team onboarding, and live operational rollout.

09 Deliver & Evolve

99.9% SLA & Evolution

Continuous monitoring, SLA-backed support, and new module expansion as you scale.

09 — COMMON QUESTIONSQuestions Business OwnersActually Ask

No technical jargon. Clear answers to the questions that matter when planning a custom ERP, CRM, or workflow system with CodnestX.

Absolutely. Most of our clients are business owners and operations leaders, not technical experts. We translate your business problems into structured software systems. You describe the workflow, the pain points, and the outcomes you want—we handle the architecture, UI/UX, and implementation in clear business language.

That is exactly how most successful projects start. You know your business—we know how to build systems. During our discovery process, we map your current workflow, identify where work is leaking, and recommend the right custom ERP or CRM blueprint before writing code.

We use a business-first approach to AI. First, we map your workflow and identify repetitive, rule-based, or data-heavy tasks. AI enters only where it creates measurable speed—document processing, smart routing, and decision insights—while approvals and exceptions stay with your team.

Yes, this is one of our most common engagements. We build centralized ERP and CRM platforms that replace scattered spreadsheets and chat threads. Your sales, stock, approvals, and accounts work from one connected source of truth with full accountability.

Timeline depends on scope and workflow complexity. Focused automation tools or role-based dashboards can be delivered in 4–8 weeks, while comprehensive custom CRM, ERP, or multi-department systems typically take 3–6 months with phased milestones so you see value early.

Yes. We regularly audit and upgrade existing web applications, ERPs, and internal tools. We analyze what is working, identify operational bottlenecks, and deliver targeted module improvements or integrations that bring faster ROI than a full rebuild.

Yes. Launch is just the beginning. We provide SLA-backed post-launch support including system monitoring, bug fixes, feature enhancements, and team onboarding so your platform evolves seamlessly as your business grows.

Absolutely. We often recommend starting with a focused core module that solves your most urgent operational bottleneck—such as quote-to-order tracking or live inventory visibility—and expanding into a full ERP suite as your team adopts the system.
